title: Helios composite
description: A composite saved as a file of its own (<id>@<version>.helios-composite.json): a sub-network packaged as one node, the inner parameters it exposes and the panel that edits it. See docs/templates.md.

id.description: Stable: lowercase words of letters and digits joined by '.' or '-'.

version.description: Templates pin it; a newer one is offered, never taken silently.

nodes.description: In order: a node reads the composite's inputs (from '@') and nodes before it.

layout.description: What the channels mean: rgba, y.

params.description: Parameter values by name, tagged by kind, as in template.json.

from.description: An inner node, or '@' for the composite's own inputs.

exposed.description: An inner parameter made the composite's own, in the order shown; one name on several inner nodes links them, its interface given on the first entry. The fields after 'param' are optional: the inner parameter's own otherwise. A semantic slider gives 'drives' instead of 'node' and 'param': one number moving several inner numbers, each along its curve.

label.description: A short label, in English; the name otherwise.

group.description: The section it is shown under; sections keep the order of their first parameter.

min.description: Narrows the inner hard range of a number or a list of numbers, never widens it.

max.description: Narrows the inner hard range of a number or a list of numbers, never widens it.

soft.description: The range a slider spans by default, within the hard range: [low, high].

options.description: The options a choice keeps, in the order shown: a subset of the inner ones.

default.description: The default, tagged by kind as a node's parameters ({ "float": 0.5 }); the inner node's value otherwise. A semantic slider's: 0 within its range otherwise.

drives.description: A semantic slider's inner numbers. Its range is min and max, else the curves' domain.

drive.description: One inner number a semantic slider moves: the curve maps the slider's value (x) to the inner value (y), piecewise-linear, x strictly increasing, flat outside its first and last points; every y within the inner hard range.

workshop.description: Experimental: what makes the macro a workshop, its intent and the relative targets its exposed parameters are aimed at on each image. See docs/design/workshops.md.

intent.description: What it is for, in English.

keywords.description: English words it is found by.

targets.description: At most one per exposed number parameter, solved in this order.

zones.description: Named parts of the image a target can be measured in, each a mask drawn once from what enters the workshop.

junctions.description: The decisions left to the AI on each photo the workshop runs on: a slider's value, or a zone the AI draws.

limits.description: The bounds a run of the workshop stays within on each photo, prefilled from the test photos, and what a breach does.

sliders.description: By exposed number parameter: the values it may take (clamped, at_limit) and how far from the test value (clamped, deviation).

targets.description: By the exposed parameter a target aims: how far the measure may land from the goal (target_missed).

input_span.description: What a photo's input may measure: outside, it is unlike the test photos (unlike_test_cases).

junctions.description: By junction name: below min_confidence the fallback is used (low_confidence).

max_ai_calls.description: The AI calls a whole run may make; the junctions times the photos when left out.

on_breach.description: flag (apply, flagged), hold (not applied until fixed) or stop (the run stops).

junction.description: A decision the AI makes on each photo: an exposed number parameter's value (with the fallback used when no AI answers), or a mask_object zone's mask.

name.description: The exposed parameter it sets, or the zone it draws.

fallback.description: For a value: what is used when no AI answers.

zone.description: A named part of the image: the mask a module draws from the workshop's input (a mask_parametric on high luminance for a sky); a pixel is in the zone where the mask is at least one half.

module.description: A module with an image input and a one-channel output.

params.description: Parameter values by name, tagged by kind, as in template.json.

port.description: The output holding the mask: mask by default.

target.description: What the image should measure, and the exposed parameter moved to get there.

measure.description: luma.median and luma.high (the 99th percentile) in stops around 1.0, clip.high (the share of pixels above 1.0) in %, zone.contrast (the 95th minus the 5th percentile) in stops, zones.ratio (the zone's median minus the median of the zone it is against) in stops.

value.description: In the measure's unit; with at: input, an offset from what the input measures.

at.description: Where it is measured: the workshop's output (the default) or its input.

zone.description: The zone it is measured in; the whole image otherwise.

against.description: For zones.ratio: the zone the zone is compared with.

panel_hint.description: Which panel edits it and where that panel docks; a template's node may override it.
